verdict.rationale: Turso is a managed database service, so a documented import or migration path is a fair question to ask. The pack never documents importing an existing production database into Turso Cloud, nor any minimal-downtime cutover. The nearest items are adjacent: dumping a Turso database out for local use (export, the opposite direction), local engines opening existing SQLite files, branching from an existing Turso database, and an anecdotal Postgres-to-Turso switch with no documented path.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import an existing production database with minimal downtime using a documented migration path
